description: Harness-improvement memory. Records are shared across sessions and policy/optimizer model switches; preserve history rather than overwriting it.

root_cause.hypothesis: The repository had no persistent, structured record of why harness changes were proposed or what happened after execution, so later sessions or model/provider switches could repeat failed approaches or overlook existing protections.
evidence: The dev branch contained AGENTS.md and OpenCode command definitions but no .opencode/sim-memory.json or SIM workflow.
The existing AGENTS.md documented important runtime invariants but did not require querying a causal experiment history before changing harness behavior.

records.rationale: A Git-tracked, model-independent JSON history plus mandatory AGENTS.md lookup/append rules and a /sim command preserves causal context, makes prior failures searchable, and places guardrail review before risky harness edits.

predicted_outcome.expected_behavior: The sim-memory branch will contain a structured SIM store, a reusable /sim query/add/update command, and repository-wide instructions requiring pre-change memory review and post-experiment records.
verification_criteria: Fetch all three changed paths from the sim-memory branch.
Parse .opencode/sim-memory.json as valid JSON and confirm schema_version and records are present.
Confirm AGENTS.md retains its existing guidance and adds the required lookup, guardrail-preservation, prediction, and post-experiment recording workflow.
Confirm .opencode/command/sim.md documents query, append, update, required fields, and allowed statuses.

observed_outcome.result: All three files were created or updated on the sim-memory branch and then fetched back successfully. The JSON parsed successfully; AGENTS.md contains its prior repository guidance plus the SIM workflow; the /sim command documents query, add, and update behavior.
verification: GitHub create/update file operations returned commit SHAs.
JSON.parse succeeded on the fetched SIM store.
side_effects: Changes are isolated on the sim-memory branch; dev was not modified.
The /sim command has not yet been executed inside a local OpenCode runtime.
